$comment: Boot-payload budget (#485 D), enforced by `node scripts/check-build-manifest.mjs --budget` in the 'Build without Emscripten' CI job and mirrored into vite.config.ts build.chunkSizeWarningLimit. Sizes are raw (un-gzipped) bytes of build/assets/*.js; 1 kB = 1000 bytes like Vite's reporter. Raise a number only with a reason in the PR; lower it whenever a phase earns the room.
entryNote: Ceiling = the entry after the follow-up split (698,257 B) rounded up to the next kB. Raised 699,000 -> 707,000 B (CI unbreak, Phase A): #508 (InputHub + KeyboardMouseSource, the ghost codec v4 input track) merged into the split's branch and put the entry at 707,769 B with every main run red; ScriptedSource (?input=script only) moved behind a dynamic import (-1.4 kB) and the rest is the hub every vehicle reads each frame, so it stays on the boot path: 706,350 B, rounded up. The 700 kB target is missed by ~6 kB again. What left the entry, raw: Rapier glue + @react-three/rapier -> vendor-rapier (167 kB, statically imported so it is modulepreloaded and counted in bootJs); GLTFLoader (44 kB, first model preload), SSAOPass (12 kB, preset High) and SMAAPass (61 kB, aa tier smaa) behind composerPassModules, KTX2Loader + zstddec (60 kB, only fetched on a GPU with a compressed target); RaftVehicle (23 kB), WgslSweSim (22 kB, native WebGPU only); PauseMenu / SettingsPanel / RunResultsPanel and the physics / wireframe / SWE-bed overlays; LevelLoader and ReachManager + ReachStreamer + ReactiveAudio (?level= and ?reach= only); fauna, biome props and set pieces as one `extras` chunk (42 kB, preloaded at idle). Per-biome loading was NOT done per biome: the biome-exclusive decorations are ~38 kB pre-minify in total, so they share the chunk with the fauna instead of adding one request per biome. The bundled map JSON (~43 kB) is still in the entry: maps/registry.ts is read synchronously by MapSystem, routing, the StartMenu and the persistence layer.
totalJsNote: All-chunks ceiling: a growth guard, no longer a target. Issue #485 asked for <= 3.5 MB; getting there needs ~53 kB of code removed, not moved, and each lazy split adds a few kB of overhead (validators +3.2 kB; this split +10 kB: 3,542,049 -> 3,552,565 B). The metric that matters for a player is bootJsMaxBytes above, so the 3.5 MB target is retired in its favour (the second option in the follow-up issue's acceptance). Ceiling = today's number rounded up. History: #487 Phase A 3,518,645 B (+2.6 kB, terrain tile mirror); #487 Phase B 3,542,049 B (+23.4 kB, mesh builders + light pool + the sim worker's copy); CI unbreak Phase A 3,562,432 B (+9.9 kB, #508's input hub and ghost codec v4).
bootJsNote: Boot JS = the entry plus every chunk index.html modulepreloads (Vite's static-import closure of the entry): entry 698,257 + vendor-three 1,119,187 + vendor-rapier 167,144 = 1,984,588 B, rounded up to the next kB. Raised 1,985,000 -> 1,993,000 B (CI unbreak, Phase A) for #508's input hub, same reason as entryNote: entry 706,350 + vendor-three 1,119,187 + vendor-rapier 167,144 = 1,992,681 B. It was ~2,295 kB (a 1,174.7 kB entry + a 1,120.3 kB vendor-three) before the split, so the boot closure fell by ~310 kB raw, not just moved: GLTFLoader, SMAA/SSAO, the raft, the WGSL stepper, the Reach path, the overlays and the extras are outside it. KTX2Loader and (on medium/high) SMAAPass are still fetched during a typical boot, but as lazy chunks that no static import waits on. The GLSL boot never fetches three.webgpu or the node stack.
